summary: the cases of tests/cases/guest.pools.json, with a kernel that refuses a pty past the thirty-second, one that leaks every pipe it frees and one that leaks every pipe's ring, each caught by its own case

argv: sh tests/proofs/guest.sh make rach2 tests && sh tests/proofs/guest.sh copy ${WORK} rach2/kernel tests/poolprobe
exec sh tests/proofs/guest.sh run pools 'run: pools: PASS'

faults.name: pty-pool-32
faults.summary: pty.c refuses a pty whose index would be 32 or more, so forty cannot be live at once

lines: @etude 1 assert ptys fail forty ptys at once

faults.name: pipe-leak
faults.summary: pipe.c frees a pipe's ring and not the pipe, so a thousand pipes leave the heap larger

lines: @etude 1 assert pipe-heap fail a thousand pipes made and closed changed the heap in three tries

faults.name: pipe-ring-leak
faults.summary: pipe.c frees a pipe and not its ring, so a thousand pipes, each written a byte, leave the heap larger or run it out

lines: @etude 1 assert pipe-heap fail a thousand pipes
